data.title: 菲奥娜 · 地下球场的破空抽击
data.description: 【菲奥娜 · 地下球场的破空抽击】坎贝尔顿地下网球赛的聚光灯耀眼夺目，全场观众屏息凝视。菲奥娜身着白色无袖运动球衫与飘逸百褶短裙，双足蹬地凌空飞跃。球拍在空气中划出凌厉的风压残影，网球如炮弹般轰然砸向对手半场。晶莹的汗珠沿她雪白的下颌飞溅，冷静淡漠的灰瞳深处点燃了为了前辈誓夺胜利的狂怒烈焰。
data.action: 腾空挥动球拍，击出强力破风抽球
data.lighting: 球场顶部的耀眼聚光灯
data.promptProse: Fiona drives upward from the underground Campbelldon court in her white sleeveless tennis top and pleated skirt, swinging her tournament racket through a forceful shot. The wide dynamic view keeps the airborne ball traveling toward the opponent's half, with the net separating both sides and spectator rows beyond. Overhead spotlights pick out her wristbands and flying sweat, placing a clear moving shadow beneath her feet.
